topics.topic: Project alias field type and representation of absence
questions: Make the alias declaration state its explicit type, including its permitted absence.
Replace this with a field declaration that gives the alias its complete type, including whether absence is represented as an optional value.

quotes:
Field names, types,
formal optionality and every answer shape belong to State 6; orders, replay
mechanisms, correction semantics and token scopes belong to State 2 (State 0,
"Carried to later states"; codex round-01 T5). SPEC_STANDARD §5's rule that
every field is declared with its type is a rule of the specification's
`models` section, and that section is State 6's output
(`skills/spec-authoring/AUTHORING_SEQUENCE.md`): State 6 writes each model
here with every fact as a typed field, and declares there what this state
decides — its identity and its kind (§5, §15.1.1).
judgement.why: The alias's formal type and representation of optionality are explicitly assigned to the State 6 models schema, so the §5 typed-field rule does not apply to this State 1 domain description.

topics.topic: Actions permitted to set, replace, or clear a project alias
questions: Which product actions may first set, replace, or clear a Project alias: project creation, project correction, import, or some specified subset?

quotes:
3. An optional value given as an empty string or white space only is absent.
4. A present value is refused when it is outside the form State 1 declares,
   at stage (4) of A04 rule 6, every such value named: an alias longer than
   40 characters, counted as Unicode code points (R0-90, M01) — its length
   only, its content being the owner's rule (R0-82); an object kind
   outside `apartment`, `house`, `commercial`, `other` (M02); a floor area not
   greater than zero, a number of rooms below 1, or a floor that is not a
   whole number (M02); a customer language outside `es`, `ru`, `en` (M04). An
   absent object kind, characteristic or customer language is never refused
   (rule 3); a Customer's kind stays required (rule 1). The same checks hold
   for every action that gives the value — a create, a correction, and the
   names and aliases the import's mapping gives (A16 rule 1).

1. 'Correct a project' gives every editable fact of the project: display name,
   alias, customer link and the object — address, kind, characteristics
   (R0-45). 'Correct a customer' gives every editable fact of the Customer:
   kind, contact data, fiscal data (R0-80).
2. An optional fact the correction does not give is cleared; there is no
   partial correction.
1. A project correction without an alias clears the alias.
judgement.why: State 2 decides that creation, correction and import may supply an alias, that correction replaces it, and that omitting it from a correction clears it.

topics.topic: Disclosure and snapshot retention rules for aliases containing personal data
questions: When an alias actually contains a person's name, an address, or another identifying value, does its field classification still permit it to reach the agent and remain in a consumer snapshot, or do R0-25, R0-26, and R0-80 prohibit those outcomes because the value is personal data?

quotes:
So an alias whose content breaks the rule does reach the agent and a
consumer's kept snapshot (R0-82), as a room name that breaks R0-68's rule
reaches the agent. This breaks neither R0-26 nor R0-80: the alias is held as
`business_confidential`, not `personal_data` (State 1, "Disclosure classes by
field"), and Registry's guarantees that no `personal_data` value reaches an
agent and that no other service keeps one cover the values it holds in that
class. Registry cannot tell a person's name from another word (R0-68), so
the one protection it gives the alias is its length; the owner's rule on its
content is the rest, and Registry promises nothing further about a value
that breaks it.
judgement.why: The text explicitly classifies even a rule-breaking alias as business_confidential and says that it reaches the agent and remains in the consumer snapshot without violating R0-26 or R0-80.
